confidence_notes: Based on the six permitted searches (one RBA FX lookup, five price lookups). I read search-result summaries only, not full pages. Numbeo, MyLifeElsewhere, CityCost and Expatistan snippets broadly agree on roughly INR 145-175 for an inexpensive meal, INR 140-155 for a cappuccino and INR 150-180 for a beer. Samples are thin and some snapshots date from late 2025, so I nudged beer and the mid-range meal up modestly for restaurant and bar pricing. No Varanasi glass-of-wine price was found. Wine and cocktail are set at roughly 2.0-2.2x the local beer price, with the cocktail above Expatistan's INR 326 downtown-club guess, so those two are low certainty. INR prices were converted to USD at an assumed ~INR 93-94 per USD (sources implied about 90-100), which is not an RBA rate. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July monsoon low season, drawn from general knowledge of Varanasi's hostel and hotel market. I ran no accommodation searches and inspected no live listings, so these are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other low-cost North Indian tourist and pilgrimage cities such as Lucknow and Agra. Expatistan comparison-page titles in the search results put Varanasi about 8% above Lucknow and about 9% below Pune on overall cost of living. Accommodation tiers follow typical Varanasi ghat-area backpacker-hostel and mid-range hotel price levels from general knowledge.
